question: Which celebrity couple just quietly fell apart?
story: Julia Garner and her husband just quietly deleted every photo of each other, and neither one has said a single word. If you don't know the names, you know the faces. Garner is the Ozark and Fantastic Four star. Her husband is Mark Foster, the guy behind Foster the People, yes, the Pumped Up Kicks band. According to multiple outlets, the two have separated after almost seven years of marriage. They got married back in December 2019. And here's the part the internet noticed first. Before any statement, before any headline, the photos just vanished. Fans went to their pages and every trace of the relationship was gone. The wild twist? They reportedly first met all the way back in 2013 at Sundance, but didn't start dating until years later. Six years to get together. And it ended in total silence. No post. No caption. Just an empty grid.
